name: lw_39
statement: (x : ℝ) (h₀ : Real.sin x + Real.sin (5 * x) + Real.sin (3 * x) = 0) : Real.sin (3 * x) = 0 ∨ 2 * Real.cos x + 1 = 0
closed: ∀ (x : ℝ) (h₀ : Real.sin x + Real.sin (5 * x) + Real.sin (3 * x) = 0), Real.sin (3 * x) = 0 ∨ 2 * Real.cos x + 1 = 0
informal: (\sin x+\sin5x)+\sin3x =(2 \sin3x \cos x)+\sin3x = \sin3x(2 \cos x+1) = 0\nThis means $\sin3x = 0$ or $2\cos x+1=0$
